title: Claude Code Plan Mode: Make AI Plan Before It Codes
description:
AI that codes first breaks things. Make it plan first! 🧠

✅ Write a short planning prompt: what to read, files, steps
✅ Tell the agent not to edit code yet
✅ Start Claude Code in plan mode with one command

Day 4 of Spec-Driven AI! Next up, Day 5: Write the Test First, Let AI Pass It.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #aicoding #claudecode #vibecoding #aiagents #codingagents #specdrivendevelopment #programming
comment: Plan mode or checklist: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: in plan mode Claude proposes a plan and waits, so read it and say no if the file list looks wrong.
